# DandyLions hub

> Single source of truth for DandyLions (founder Fabio Bortolazzi): design system, voice and published source material for LinkedIn and Instagram content. Read-only reference maintained by Ruben Bijker. Never invent facts or quotes; gaps are marked [TO BE SUPPLIED BY RUBEN: ...].

Everything in one file: https://rbijkercom.github.io/dandylions-hub/llms-full.txt

## Start here

- [README.md](https://rbijkercom.github.io/dandylions-hub/): What the hub is and its rules
- [project-instructions.md](https://rbijkercom.github.io/dandylions-hub/project-instructions.html): Instructions for Claude: sources, voice, LinkedIn and Instagram, output format

## Voice

- [voice/voice-and-tone.md](https://rbijkercom.github.io/dandylions-hub/voice/voice-and-tone.html): Who speaks (I vs we), tone, vocabulary, style rules
- [voice/multilingual-glossary.md](https://rbijkercom.github.io/dandylions-hub/voice/multilingual-glossary.html): Official EN / IT / NL terms

## Design system

- [design-system/brand-rules.md](https://rbijkercom.github.io/dandylions-hub/design-system/brand-rules.html): Name, tagline, logo and lion mark, graphic devices, imagery, do and don't
- [design-system/social-formats.md](https://rbijkercom.github.io/dandylions-hub/design-system/social-formats.html): LinkedIn and Instagram sizes, safe zones, Figma templates
- [design-system/tokens.json](https://rbijkercom.github.io/dandylions-hub/design-system/tokens.json): Colours, themes, typography, spacing, radius, grain
